LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 6 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should one use adverbs correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a short video and pick out the adverbs of frequency and degree used by the speakers,

2. identify the adverbs of frequency and degree from a text,

3. construct sentences using adverbs of frequency and degree,

4. hold conversations using the adverbs of frequency and degree,

5. fill in crossword puzzles,

6. search online for more examples of adverbs of frequency and degree.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a short video and pick out the adverbs of frequency and degree used by the speakers,
2. identify the adverbs of frequency and degree from a text,
3. construct sentences using adverbs of frequency and degree,
4. hold conversations using the adverbs of frequency and degree,
5. fill in crossword puzzles,
6. search online for more examples of adverbs of frequency and degree.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Imagination and creativity: It is sharpened as the learner constructs correct sentences using adverbs.

Values:
Respect: It is enhanced as the learner learns to value human dignity while helping peers to construct sentences correctly.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is enhanced as the learner uses adverbs of frequency and degree in the spoken and written contexts.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner relates the concept of adverbs to the learning of word classes in Kiswahili.
